{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the main network event loop in src/net.cpp to handle POLLERR and POLLHUP directly when reads are paused.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Directly disconnecting on socket errors during paused reads avoids a doomed send attempt and clarifies logging. As the author notes, 'This just adds clarity: previously we would attempt a send that would then fail. The only side-effect is a changed log message.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/httpserver.cpp to handle socket hangup and error events separately in the HTTP server event loop.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change avoids redundant failed system calls when HTTP connections drop unexpectedly. The impact is minor cleanup of error handling and log messages without changing HTTP interface semantics."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Framework changes in test_framework.py and netutil.py only serve the new functional tests for P2P and HTTP socket errors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning behavior of specific areas belong to those areas rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates socket abstraction methods in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Extends the Sock utility interface to distinguish error conditions from read readiness. This is a minor internal refinement of shared socket utilities."
    }
  ],
